Handle problems directly rather than escalating them. • Be the voice of the customer inside Sarvam: relay model feedback (transcription errors, voice quality gaps, translation failures, LLM output issues) to research and engineering with enough specificity that they can reproduce and prioritise; then close the loop with the customer. • Surface market insights: track what customers and prospects are building, map the competitive landscape, spot recurring patterns across accounts, and bring a point of view to GTM and Product — not just a data dump. Bonus Points • Familiarity with speech, LLM, or document processing APIs: you know what good output looks like. • Experience working with engineering or research teams: you can turn a customer complaint into a reproducible bug report. • You’ve built something with an API — a project, a side build, anything.
